groups.activity: rank to 5 (Old Mate), then clear Profit-Taker phases 1-3
groups.meta: opens the Heists and the Archgun Deployer

rows.label: Solaris United Rank 5, Old Mate
rows.note: daily-capped standing; each rank-up needs a Debt-Bond sacrifice

conditions: Without the Archgun Deployer (from finishing heist phase 3), Larkspur only works in Archwing, not on the ground.
Medical Debt-Bonds are the rank-up item that holds most players up; Ticker sometimes sells them in bulk.

groups.meta: 100% drop, 1 per kill; phase 4 repeats freely after the first clear
conditions: Bring at least 3 weapons with different elements — the shield only takes damage from the element it's currently showing.
Kill the pylons/beacons and the adds; ignoring them causes the stagger that kills pug runs.
Don't redeem your first Crisma Toroids to Little Duck — you need 3 for Larkspur before spending any on Vox standing.
bonuses: Void damage (operator amp) cycles the shield's element on a ~5s cooldown.
Buffing frames (Chroma, Mirage, Rhino, Octavia, Harrow, Volt) speed the fight; Chroma's Effigy doubles the 125k credit drop.
Stagger immunity (Primed Sure Footed, or Sure Footed + Power Drift) beats Handspring here.
An Arch-gun-carrier Corpus enemy drops an ammo crate that resets the whole squad's Deployer cooldown.

disclosures.title: no repeatable shortcut
disclosures.body: One player reported a Crisma Toroid from a Twitch drop, but Profit-Taker phase 4 is the only farmable source.
